definition: WINDOW_SPEC.md scheme W (definition as of the 2026-10-09 changelog): D_l = D^zm + D^M; h(l) = X Lambda X^-1 from the auxiliary channels with the degenerate partners of z >= 5 removed from the resolvent (sec. 2.10), D^M = (1/4){Delta c_1(l, N), M'}; all orders, self-consistent
precision_note: exact rationals: RS modulo 208 primes < 2^23, CRT over 200 + rational reconstruction, every value verified on 8 held-out primes; *_float = the rational rounded to double

W+V.doc: WINDOW_SPEC.md scheme W+V: W + D^V = (1/2){Delta c_2(l, N), V'}

WB.doc: earlier literal reading of WINDOW_SPEC 2.3/2.10 (before the 2026-10-09 change): h from the branch eigenvectors with the B-equation in the auxiliary channels (partner components included)

W+VB.doc: W+V with the earlier literal reading (B-equation in the auxiliary channels)

W2.doc: W with windows of order eps^2 only (D^(k>=3) = 0; WINDOW_SPEC sec. 5.2; reproduces the sec. 8 values)

WnoM.doc: W without D^M (check: equals consistent through eps^3)

WM2.doc: diagnostic: W with D^M truncated at eps^2 (D^zm at all orders)

WM3.doc: diagnostic: W with D^M truncated at eps^3 (D^zm at all orders)

W2B.doc: WB with windows of order eps^2 only

Wn.doc: legacy: B-equation in the auxiliary channels, but h^(2) from the explicit second-order sum

W+Vn.doc: legacy: W+V with the Wn convention

W2n.doc: legacy: Wn with windows of order eps^2 only (= W2 at eps^4)

complete2.doc: residual_log README eps^2 window: D = eps^2 [D^zm(naive h^(2)) - (1/(27 pi)) {N, M'_0}]; exact polynomials in t = 1/pi

window_tables.doc: h: 'k|z'|z' -> {l: h^(k)_{z'z}(l)} (monomial frame, claimed entries of results/book_W_V_desc.json); c1, c2: k -> {l: c^(k)(l)}; E_z: 'z,l' -> {order: E_z^(order)(l)} (claimed orders)
